question: After allowing a discount of 60% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for ₹49,834. Find its marked price (in ₹). 647
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount = 60% ⇒ Selling Price = 40% of Marked Price

SP = 49834 = 40% of MP

MP = 49834 ÷ 0.40 = 49834 × (5/2)

MP = 24917 × 5 = 124585

**∴ Answer = 124585**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Discount = 60%, Selling Price = 49834

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − Discount%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × (1 − 60/100)

⇒ 49834 = MP × 0.40

⇒ MP = 49834 ÷ 0.40

⇒ MP = 49834 × (5/2)

⇒ MP = 124585

**∴ The correct answer is 124585.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Formula

SP = MP × (1 − discount%)

Reverse Percentage

Original value = Given value ÷ remaining percentage

Shortcut Trick

Convert percentage into fraction for faster calculation

Key Insight

After discount, remaining % directly links SP and MP
